name: markout-vscode
description: Markout language support for VS Code: the compiler's diagnostics, in the editor

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "throw new Error('markout-vscode goes to the Marketplace with vsce, never to npm: npm run package')"

author: Fabrizio Capolini

markout.docroot.markdownDescription: The directory pages are resolved against, so that `/lib.htm` means the same thing here as it does when served. An array names several, for a window open on more than one project: each file is read against the innermost one that contains it. Empty falls back to `markout.docroot` in the nearest `package.json`, then to a guess -- the nearest ancestor named `markout`, then the nearest one with a `package.json`, then the workspace folder.

enumDescriptions: Look for evidence: a page using markout's own syntax, or a project that depends on markout.
Diagnose every HTML file, whatever the project.
markout.enable.markdownDescription: When to compile HTML files and report what the compiler says. `auto` looks for evidence: a page that uses markout's own syntax (a `<:…>` directive, or an attribute like `:count=${…}`), or a project that depends on markout. It stays silent otherwise, because a `.html` file holding `${…}` is JSP EL or Thymeleaf at least as often as it is a markout page.
